en: Sepia-toned historic postcard showing the ornate Gothic façade of a large civic building with tall spires, pinnacles, and richly decorated window tracery. Below the photograph is a printed French caption identifying the site as Bruges' Hôtel de Ville, followed by descriptive text about the building's history and construction. A small circular logo appears at the lower left, and publisher information is printed along the bottom margin.
